outcome: Fix Ada-ef offline estimation: align per-query recall with score groups, repair the ef-search stall condition, and revert sampling to include self
criteria: In RecallEstimator::init (hnswlib/adaptive_ef.h), each query's score is paired with that same query's recall; the compacted recalls vector is no longer indexed by the score_list position, so no out-of-bounds read occurs. Zero-recall queries remain excluded from per-group averages (filter semantics unchanged).

In EfAdapter::init, the stall break compares latest_agg_recall (not latest_ef) against expected_recall, and a non-positive or non-finite recall_diff no longer collapses the ef step to k/2 through an undefined float-to-int cast; the loop terminates either at target recall or at ef_upper_bound.
run_offline_ada (experiments_driver/util.h) calls compute_samplings with exclude_self=false, so sampling GT and search both include the sample point itself, matching the original run.cpp flow.
sample_data draws indices from [0, rows-1] so the re-enabled sampling path cannot read a row past the end of the data matrix.

dispositions.note: RecallEstimator::init pairs score_list[i] with recalls_ori[i]; only non-zero recalls enter grouped_recalls, all queries enter score_to_query_map, and all-zero groups keep a stats row (count = group size) so both estimators share one key set.

stall break now compares latest_agg_recall; step is computed in float, secant only when recall_diff is positive and finite, doubled otherwise, clamped to [max(1,k/2), ef_upper_bound-latest_ef] before the int cast; agg_recall guarded against empty recalls.
run_offline_ada calls compute_samplings without exclude_self, restoring the original include-self flow; exclude_self code path left in place but unused.
